then.text: The fleece is for the market display? Lovely. The monks would approve. They'd have sold it to Florence, mind.

else.text: Kirkstall's wool went as far as Italy. Merchants bought it years ahead. The monks ran up debts doing deals on wool they hadn't sheared yet.
Here, take this fleece from the farm shop for the market. Kirkstall to Kirkgate, wool all the way.
{greeting} White monks, grey stone, eight hundred years. The roof went in Henry's time, but the walls are tough as old boots.
Painters loved this place. Turner came and sketched it. So did a lot of people with less talent and bigger hats.
